hints.title: Level-Sum Property
hints.text: The sum of all cousins of a node equals the total sum of all nodes at that level minus the sum of siblings sharing the same parent.

hints.title: Two-Pass Level Traversal
hints.text: First compute the total sum of each tree depth, then traverse again to replace each child's value.

hints.title: Sibling Sum Subtraction
hints.text: For each parent, compute the sum of its immediate children. For each child, its new value is level_sum minus sibling_sum.

hints.title: Level-Order Replacement Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Breadth traversal computes next level sum and subtracts sibling values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching parent and cousins for every individual node takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(w) queue space for current level nodes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes cousin sum is level sum minus sibling sum and implements clean level-order traversal.
